app.name: Financial Calculator
app.title: Financial Calculator · Can I take this loan?

footer.privacy: Your data is stored only in this browser. There is no server and no external database.
footer.disclaimer: Results are for guidance only and are not financial advice. The final terms of a loan are set by each institution.

privacy_notice.title: Your data stays in your browser
privacy_notice.intro: Before you start, here is what happens with the information you enter:

points.local: Everything is stored only in this browser, on this device.
points.no_server: There is no server, account or external database: nobody else can see your information.
points.control: You can delete everything at any time with the “Delete my data” button at the bottom of the page.
points.device: If you clear your browser data or switch devices, the information does not come with you.

clear_data.message: Your income, expenses, debts and saved offers will be removed from this browser. This cannot be undone.
clear_data.success: None of your information is stored in this browser anymore.
clear_data.error: We could not delete your data. Please try again.

home.title: Can I take this loan?
home.description: Compare your real financial situation with the offer your bank is making and get a clear answer before you sign.

profile.title: Your finances
profile.description: Your net income, your monthly expenses and the debts you are already paying.

offer.title: The bank's offer
offer.description: Amount, annual rate, disbursement fee, term and, if applicable, insurance and other charges.

result.title: The result
result.description: Your monthly payment, what the loan really costs and whether you can take it without overextending yourself.

income.title: How much do you earn each month?
income.description: Add all your steady income. You can combine salary, business and other income, each in its own currency.
income.incomplete: Add at least one income and enter the amount of each one to continue.

expenses.title: How much do you spend each month?
expenses.description: Include what you pay every month to live. Leave out your debt payments: those go in the next step.
expenses.incomplete: Add at least one expense and enter the amount of each one to continue.

debts.title: Which debts are you paying?
debts.description: Cards, loans and credit you already have. If you have no debts, leave this step empty.
debts.incomplete: Enter the payment and the balance of each debt to continue.

amount_hint.salary: What you receive after deductions (IHSS, RAP, income tax).
amount_hint.business: What you sell in a normal month.
amount_hint.other: Steady income only: rent, pensions or regular remittances.

income.costs_hint: Inventory, rent for the premises, employees and other costs.

hint.utilities: Water, electricity, internet, phone and cable.
hint.transport: Fuel, bus, taxi and vehicle maintenance.
hint.other: Any other expense you have every month.

debts.monthly_payment_hint: What you pay each month for this debt.
debts.annual_rate_hint: It is in your contract or account statement.
debts.remaining_months_hint: How many payments you have left.

summary.title: Your monthly summary
summary.autosave: Your changes are saved automatically in this browser.

exchange_rate.label: Exchange rate
exchange_rate.hint: Lempiras per dollar. We use it to add amounts in different currencies.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.message: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.

errors.save_failed: We could not save your changes in this browser. Check that storage is not blocked or full.
